title: External causes of death, life expectancy, and lifespan inequality in Brazil, 2010–2023: code and data
description: R code and processed data to reproduce the results of: Marques DHF, Calazans JA, Aburto JM, Acosta E, Nepomuceno MR. External causes of death, life expectancy, and lifespan inequality in Brazil, 2010–2023. Revista Panamericana de Salud Pública / Pan American Journal of Public Health. 2026. The code decomposes the change in life expectancy at birth (e0) and lifespan inequality (life disparity, e†) by age and cause of death for Brazil and its 27 states, by sex, using the method of Horiuchi, Wilmoth and Pletcher (2008).
